summary: Recent updates to Firefox's 2D graphics system, known as Thebes, include a significant change where the property “font-stretch” has been renamed to **font-width** to clarify its purpose in font rendering. This should improve readability and user understanding when dealing with typography styles. Additionally, support for High Dynamic Range (HDR) displays has been enhanced by allowing users to query HDR display information directly in the "about:support" page, which provides insights into the capabilities of their display hardware. Various optimizations in text rendering were also made, such as improving how text is measured and cached, which can lead to faster rendering of text on web pages. This overall streamlining in graphic processing helps ensure a smoother, more efficient browsing experience, especially for those using complex fonts or viewing content on high-end displays.
